# reselling_load_balancer (Resource)

A load balancer in a VPC with a public IPv4 address. Services (listeners), targets and certificates are separate resources. Deleting moves it to the trash for 48 hours.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reselling_load_balancer_plans" "small" {
  name = "small"
}

resource "reselling_load_balancer" "web" {
  name        = "web-lb"
  location_id = reselling_vpc.backend.location_id
  vpc_id      = reselling_vpc.backend.id
  plan_id     = data.reselling_load_balancer_plans.small.plans[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location_id` (String)
- `name` (String) Name. Changed in place.
- `plan_id` (String) Plan (see `reselling_load_balancer_plans`). Changed in place; a smaller plan must still fit the configuration.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC the targets are reached through.

### Optional

- `enable_ipv6` (Boolean)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ipv4_address` (String)
- `ipv6_address` (String)
- `private_ip` (String)
- `status` (String)

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_load_balancer.web <load_balancer_id>
```
